written.headline: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
written.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia on Thursday to investigate whether former CEO Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China obtaining advanced chips or confidential information. The probe also examines whether the company misled investors and the public regarding the risks.

written.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies
written.summary: The US Commerce Department approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies as of May 2026, according to disclosures released by House Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast. The approvals included entities on the Department of Defense's Chinese military-linked list.

written.headline: Study examines EU AI Act references on Hugging Face repository cards and discussions
written.summary: Researchers conducted an empirical study of explicit references to the European Union's AI Act on Hugging Face using over five million records. They found that explicit references remain rare across all repository types.

written.headline: Google DeepMind institute outlines four pathways from AGI to ASI
written.summary: Google DeepMind researchers published an essay outlining four pathways for AI development to move from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence (ASI). The essay notes that global effective compute has grown at least tenfold per year.

written.headline: Bipartisan House lawmakers form AI Safety and Innovation Caucus
written.summary: A bipartisan group of over two dozen House lawmakers formed the AI Safety and Innovation Caucus to balance mitigating AI risks with maintaining U.S. leadership in AI. The 26-member caucus includes seven Republicans and is co-chaired by Representatives George Whitesides, Nathaniel Moran, and Don Beyer.

written.headline: Deutsche Telekom invests €100 million in French AI start-up Mistral
written.summary: Deutsche Telekom's T.Capital Tech Fund invested €100 million in French artificial intelligence company Mistral. The investment marks a first step toward a strategic partnership to support companies and the public sector in Germany.

written.headline: AI agents redesign engineering parts with CAD parameters and simulations
written.summary: Researchers showed that GPT-6 Astra can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations. Using a budget of 15 simulations, the AI lowered the strain in a magnesium stent's bends by 32%.
